title: Longest Common Prefix
summary: Find the longest string that starts every word in strs.
statement: Find the longest string that starts every word in strs. Return an empty string when no first character is shared.

examples.explanation: The words first differ after min.
The empty word cannot share a nonempty prefix.

hints: Conceptual: A common prefix cannot extend beyond the shortest word.
Directional: Compare the words at the same character position.
Implementation: Scan positions of the first word and stop at the first missing or differing character.
complexityAnalysis: O(total input characters) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
